name: עֲזִיזָא
summary: One of the sons of Zattu who had taken foreign wives and put them away in Ezra's day (Ezr 10:27). The name is the adjective “strong” in an Aramaic shape (Jewish Aramaic עַזִּיז, with the ending ־ָא); scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, וַעֲזִיזָא.”

note: BDB's p.bx.ai, one token. The Aramaic reading rests on the form, not on any verse.
